message: Selected-grid fixed-Q thermal gray-law AD-FD is validated for p=1,2,3 on grown/grown interfaces and for the p=1 evaporated/evaporated endpoint. Finest-step errors are 2.290e-6, 2.079e-6, 1.451e-6, and 2.707e-6, with h-to-h/2 convergence. Worst residual is 9.996e-11, worst energy-balance error is 8.809e-12, and all linear solves used CUDA float64 without CPU fallback. Gray-law choice is material: p=2/p=3 rotate the fixed-Q thermal gradient by 5.363/9.800 degrees versus p=1. This isolates only the thermal branch; coupled optical gray-law sensitivity, the selected-grid Maxwell adjoint and combined directions, exact-binary DRC fixtures, and full latent AD-FD still block optimization.
